I am old now, 86 years, and my strength is not what it was. This maize plot near the house is small, less than half a hectare, and I depend on it for our nsima. If I get the coupon from FISP this year, I will use the fertilizer — NPK at planting and urea for topdressing — because without it the maize does not yield well on this tired soil. I also put the kraal manure from my few goats before the rains come. My sons and grandchildren help me work the land, and for weeding I sometimes pay a young man from the village because my back cannot bend for long.
